title: oKtopure High Throughput DNA Extraction Robot Premier Service

description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number #1232SA26Q0446 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for oKtopure High Throughput DNA Extraction Robot Premier Service Contract This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 334516 – Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing The small business size standard is 1,000. This acquisition is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
